content.title: See which former NFL names are part of UFL 2026
content.text: SPORTSUFL set to kick off 2026 season with 8 teamsBarry WernerList WireMarch 26, 2026, 7:24 p.m. ETKeep WatchingThe attempt to have a successful spring football league continues. The United Football League season opens on Friday with eight teams, some new and others established. The UFL announced that it had hired billionaire horse racing owner Mike Repole as its managing partner of operations heading into 2026.There are new rules, too. One is that field goals from 60 yards or more will count for four points.There are other challenges, too, such as trying to gain a television or streaming audience during a time of year when many other sports are in play.Who are the eight teams that will play in UFL 2026?Birmingham StallionsCoach: AJ McCarronColumbus AviatorsCoach: Ted Ginn Jr.Dallas RenegadesCoach: Rick NeuheiselDC DefendersCoach: Shannon HarrisHouston GamblersCoach: Kevin SumlinLouisville KingsCoach: Chris RedmanOrlando StormCoach: Anthony BechtSt. Louis BattlehawksCoach: Ricky ProehlUFL scheduleWeek 1 will see the Birmingham Stallions vs. Louisville Kings (Friday, 8 p.m. ET), FOX; DC Defenders vs. St. Louis Defenders (Saturday, noon, ESPN), Houston Gamblers vs. Dallas Renegades (Saturday, FOX, 4 p.m.), and Columbus Aviators vs. Orlando Storm (Sunday, ESPN, 8 p.m.).Seniors Born 1939-1969 Receive 11 Benefits This Month If They AskSuper Saving Online | SponsoredSponsoredUndo$25 Patch Is Going Viral After Shocking Weight Loss PhotosBetterLiving | SponsoredSponsoredUndoSide Sleepers Get Achy Shoulders, Few Know This "Side Sleeper" TrickSleep Digest Publication | SponsoredSponsoredUndoIf You Get Social Security, Don't Skip This April Benefit CheckHealthyWallet | SponsoredSponsoredLearn moreUndoby Taboolaby TaboolaBrought to you by- | SponsoredSponsoredUndoYou Eat Clean But Still Have Gut Problems — Here's The Real ReasonGundry MD | SponsoredSponsoredGo To QuizUndo40+?
